name: ASV Soccer
description:
About This Game

Welcome to ASV Soccer, a highly customizable arcade soccer game.

With ASV Soccer you can enjoy:

  • Up to 22 player multiplayer for true 11 vs 11 matches.

  • Seamless drop-in and drop-out. Your time is precious: from kicking a few balls in a couple of minutes, to playing multiple matches consecutively, anything goes.

  • Phsyics based ball behaviour with no predetermined outcomes.

  • Extensive customization options: Choose between Arcade or Realism presets, or use a custom combination: Many aspects can be customized, such as preventing the ball from leaving the field, fouls, offsides, player collision, slow-mo effects and many others.

  • Switch to any player: Perform strong well-timed tackles as defender, display vision and ball distribution as playmaker, be in the correct position and score goals as forward or keep a clean sheet as goalkeeper - it's all up to you.

  • Matches against AI prepare you for your multiplayer experience.

  • Seamless switching between First Person, Third Person, and Television Camera modes for maximum overview or maximum immersion. Play the way you like it.

  • Comprehensive controls: Carefully chose your player actions yourself. No context-aware actions bound to a single button, no auto-aim, it's all up to you.

  • Play on the go: Works great and is actively tested on the Steam Deck. Play a game wherever you want.

Thanks for supporting the game, and I hope you enjoy ASV Soccer.
short_desc: ASV Soccer is an up to 22 player arcade multiplayer soccer game for true 11 vs 11 matches with seamless drop-in and drop-out. Switch to first-person, third-person , and television camera modes at any time, and enjoy modern visuals with realistic physics based ball behaviour.
